title: Local sign-in connection restored
summary: Restarted the missing local learning API with network access to the existing authentication database.

changes.detail: Operational recovery: started the existing backend on 127.0.0.1:3002. The initial sandboxed process could not reach PostgreSQL (EACCES); replaced that process with a network-enabled local backend. No authentication code, credentials or account settings changed.

validation.name: Authentication configuration and database
validation.detail: node scripts/check-learning-owner.mjs passed with network access; session table read verified.

validation.name: Real browser-to-backend connection
validation.detail: A fresh Edge browser on localhost:8081/change-history sent an empty JSON request to the real local auth API without interception. Received expected HTTP 400 INVALID_INPUT, replacing the unavailable connection/503. CORS preflight returned 204 with the correct localhost origin.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: User password was not supplied or tested. Successful account sign-in remains for the user to verify. Backend must remain running; no production deployment or native device check.
